Subject: Vendor registration & PO details needed for Redwood

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Our AP team needs to finish vendor setup before we can pay the first month. Please send the following so we can create a vendor record and issue a PO:

- Completed vendor profile (company legal name, address, tax ID, remittance address)
- W-9 (or applicable tax form for non-US entities)
- Bank account details / ACH instructions (or we can use invoice remit to address)
- Standard payment terms (Net 30 / Net 45) and early-pay discounts if any
- Sample invoice template that shows the PO matching rules (what fields must match PO to avoid payment holds)

Also: is EdgeApp required to set up Redwood in our supplier portal? If so, please provide the portal link and the primary contact to be used on the record.

We typically include a copy of our PO number on the invoice header and in the invoice XML file; if you require a different field for matching, let us know.

Thanks,
AP Team
EdgeApp Inc.

Hi EdgeApp AP team (and Luke),

Thanks — attaching our standard AP onboarding packet and a completed W-9 for your records. A few notes to make vendor setup and PO matching straightforward: 

1) Company/legal information (exact values you should use):
   - Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Address: 125 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105
   - Tax ID (EIN): 83-1234567
   - Remittance: remittance@redwood.ai (preferred) / Redwood Inference, Inc., PO Box 12345, San Francisco, CA 94104

2) Bank / payment instructions:
   - We prefer ACH (bank details are included in the Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx). If you require submittal via a secure portal, let us know and we can upload.

3) Invoice & PO matching rules (summary):
   - Required: PO number must appear in the invoice header and on the invoice line items if provided by EdgeApp.
   - If PO is missing, AP will typically place invoice on hold. We can accept a one-time invoice without PO with prior approval (see below).
   - Invoice to: invoices@redwood.ai
   - Include: Invoice number, invoice date, line-item descriptions (service month, model usage units), tax/VAT if applicable.

4) Payment terms: Net 30 standard. We do not offer supplier-side early-pay discounts in standard contracts, but can discuss for strategic partners.

5) VAT / international tax note:
   - For EU customers issuing POs with VAT, please include VAT registration number and indicate whether the reverse-charge applies. We will supply invoice with VAT broken out when applicable.

6) Vendor portal:
   - Yes — EdgeApp can register at: https://documents.redwood.ai/signon/vendor-portal?token=abc123
   - Primary contact for registration: Marissa Cole, AP & Revenue Operations (marissa_cole@redwood.ai)

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Packet.pdf, Redwood_W9.pdf, Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx, Sample_Invoice_with_PO.pdf

If you prefer, I can complete EdgeApp's portal entry on your behalf once you confirm the bank details. Also looping Ava for any tax questions (EU VAT handling).

Marissa — quick question: EdgeApp said they need a PO before payment. They asked if Redwood will accept the first invoice without a PO and then have EdgeApp submit a PO retroactively within 30 days. Any risk here? From a revenue recognition and cash application standpoint, I want to make sure we won't be left with an unapplied receivable beyond 60 days.

If you think this is low risk for a strategic customer, I'm fine approving a one-time exception but would like it documented in the deal notes (DEAL-8372). If not, we should hold the invoice until PO is present.

-Markus

They requested a one-time invoice to avoid delaying supplier onboarding (they want to schedule usage immediately).

Given EdgeApp's ARR size and that this is an initial month billing only, I'm okay approving a one-time exception conditioned on: 
- We mark the invoice in our AR system as "Pending PO - Customer committed" and track via DEAL-8372.
- EdgeApp agrees in writing (email is okay) to provide the PO number within 30 days.

EdgeApp AP: can you confirm you will issue the PO within 30 days to avoid holding payments longer than that? Once you confirm, we'll proceed with invoicing this month.

Next steps for EdgeApp to finish registration:
- Complete the Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx and return it to remittance@redwood.ai (or register via portal link).
- Return bank details (if you prefer ACH) or confirm remit address for mailed checks.
- Confirm PO timing in reply.

Thanks — I will also upload the onboarding packet to the HubSpot deal (link: https://hubspot.com/contacts/DEAL-8372) so Sales has visibility.
